messages:
tanya: heads-up on PR #5562 — docs change for the generate endpoint. blocking question: what is the canonical behavior for content-type negotiation when streaming vs non-streaming? the doc currently shows curl with no Accept header (non-stream), and an env var example for streaming. need runtime confirmation.

ryan: link?

tanya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5562/files look at examples under /reference/api/generate.md.

mike: runtime note: default response is application/json for non-streaming. streaming uses text/event-stream. if Accept header includes text/event-stream server will switch to SSE. if client specifies Accept: application/json but also sends stream=true param, server prefers the header and will still return JSON (stream=false). in practice SDKs set stream flag and Accept consistently.

ryan: so we should state that server honors Accept header over query param?

mike: correct — header takes precedence. also note: some proxies strip SSE chunked responses; recommend clients set `Connection: keep-alive` and check intermediaries.

ci-bot: preview status: failed  mkdocs missing nav entry for reference/api  https://ci.redwood-inference.dev/preview/5562

tanya: i'll change the examples: 1) add explicit Accept examples for both modes, 2) note header precedence, 3) add a short proxy warning. pushing edits now.

docs-bot: reminder  add changelog and tag with docs-next. also include the runtime ack in PR description.

tanya: added changelog and runtime ack, pushing.

ci-bot: preview status: success  https://ci.redwood-inference.dev/preview/5562

ryan: quick nit: the curl streaming example used `--no-buffer` which is linux-only; changed to include a note for mac users (use `stdbuf -oL` or `python -u`).

mike: LGTM on runtime wording. note that max_tokens default is model-dependent; add parenthetical that some models use 256 by default.

tanya: updated text per feedback. who will review? need docs + runtime.

ryan: i'll do docs review.

mike: runtime sign-off after CI green.

ci-bot: preview success  ready for review.

ryan: reviewed and approved. small grammar fix. :shipit:

tanya: merged, thanks all — watching prod build for 20 minutes.
